# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Only the latest published versions of `ThorstenSauter.Azure.Cosmos.Migrations` and
`ThorstenSauter.Azure.Cosmos.Migrations.Tool` receive fixes. There are no maintained release branches.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please report security issues privately through
[GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/ThorstenSauter/Azure.Cosmos.Migrations/security/advisories/new).
Do **not** open a public issue for anything security-sensitive.

When reporting, please include:

- a description of the vulnerability and its impact,
- the steps or a proof of concept needed to reproduce it,
- the package versions and the connection method (key, Microsoft Entra ID, emulator) involved.

## What to expect

This is a small, single-maintainer project. Reports are acknowledged within a week, and you will be kept
updated on the assessment and the fix. You will be credited in the release notes unless you prefer to stay
anonymous. There is no bug bounty.
